feature: Registered localized boss names in Sect Ledger targets
scope: Official LanguageManager switches between English and Chinese and verifies active culture and loaded Chinese NPC text. Actual GetNextGuidance runs sequentially for all twelve boss targets in each language; results contain the registered NPC name, no unresolved key or format placeholder, and preserve cultivation snapshots. Original culture and world progress are restored.
limitations: Controlled direct guide calls with advanced player/world prerequisites; no physical guide use, client chat rendering, complete playthrough or live network delivery. Other hardcoded names outside these twelve target templates remain outside this change.
